description: This Swift source file defines helper functions for parsing network host and port information from strings, and generating HTTP URL strings based on provided parameters.

methods.name: parseHostPort(from:)
methods.description: Parses a string to extract host and port information, supporting IPv6 brackets and standard hostname:port formats.

methods.name: httpURLString(host:port:fallback:)
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string using given host and port, with optional brackets for IPv6 addresses, or returns a fallback URL.
